headline: A 2016 law renames a border crossing in Tornillo, Texas, as the "Marcelino Serna Port of Entry."
what_it_does: This law gives an official new name to the U.S. Customs and Border Protection port of entry at 1400 Lower Island Road in Tornillo, Texas. The new name honors Marcelino Serna. It changes only the name and does not change how the port operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on September 29, 2016.
